headline: European and Finnish health technology is active, with a big wearables IPO story and heavy public support for digital health. EU rules for devices and medical AI are being simplified but are still unsettled, and I found no reliable current market-size figure.
outlook_reason: Public funding is rising (Business Finland Health 360, Horizon Europe HLTH 2027 calls) and the proposed MDR/IVDR simplification should lower regulatory cost, though legislative and AI Act uncertainty remains.

metrics.label: Business Finland funding to Finnish health-related projects
metrics.value: over EUR 65 million (of EUR 785 million total granted to 2,500+ companies)

metrics.label: Health 360 Finland programme budget
metrics.value: EUR 20 million per year, EUR 85 million in total by 2028

metrics.value: 154 (57 in the US, 97 in Europe and elsewhere)

metrics.label: European medtech market size
metrics.value: Not found. MedTech Europe's 'European Medical Technology in Figures 2026' (updated 2026-10-06) exists, but the numbers were not readable. Older sources give roughly EUR 100-110 billion (2014-2015), which is outdated.

signals.title: Horizon Europe HLTH 2027 calls open
signals.detail: Calls opened including point-of-care diagnostics (two-stage, deadline 2027-09-16) and disabilities and independent living (deadline 2027-02-17).

signals.title: Nexstim Q3 2026 business update
signals.detail: 154 systems installed worldwide, 57 of them in the US. Joint neurosurgery marketing with Brainlab continues. A 10-system NBS 6 distributor order was announced in July 2026.

signals.title: MedTech Europe publishes 'European Medical Technology in Figures 2026'
signals.detail: New edition of the sector data hub. I could not read the headline figures.

signals.title: MDR/IVDR revision negotiations at a critical stage
signals.detail: The Commission proposal (COM(2025) 1023, 16 Dec 2025) is still in Council and Parliament. It reclassifies some devices, digitalises submissions and narrows AI Act overlap. BioMed Alliance warns about weaker clinical evidence and transparency requirements. I found no adopted text.

signals.title: Provisional AI Act omnibus deal
signals.detail: Medical devices stay under the AI Act's high-risk rules, but the dates are pushed back: reportedly 2 Aug 2028 for AI in devices and 2 Dec 2027 for standalone high-risk systems. MedTech Europe wanted more. Dates come from secondary law-firm sources and are unverified.

signals.title: Business Finland reports Health 360 results
signals.detail: Over EUR 65 million went to health projects in 2025. 7 term sheet offers came from North American pitching via the Amplify platform.

signals.title: Research Council of Finland clinical research call and Proof of Concept call
signals.detail: The clinical research call (EUR 25 million) opened in March 2026. The spring 2026 Proof of Concept call was aimed at national strategic choices. The date is approximate.
